text: Conneco is a platform designed to integrate educational resources for children aged 4-16 from various ethnic backgrounds.
The inspiration for Conneco came from its founder, a single mother, who faced significant challenges in finding suitable courses for her 6.5-year-old child.
The founder found the process of finding educational courses time-consuming and costly, fraught with high costs of trial and error.
The founder collaborated with several MBA classmates and education professors to develop Conneco.
Conneco aggregates high-quality educational resources, helping parents and children easily find appropriate courses.
The platform aims to significantly reduce the time and money spent on searching and selecting educational resources.
Each child can save $2000-$3000 annually in learning expenses through the use of Conneco.
The project's funding goal was $47,961, but it was not reached.
The project was last updated on August 26, 2024.
The project was unsuccessful in securing funding on Kickstarter.
